title: A welcome that sends you away
odia: ଆସିଲ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଭଲ କଲ, ବସିବାକୁ ନାହିଁ ଠା, ଯେଉଁ ବାଟେ ବାଟେ ଆସିଲ ବନ୍ଧୁ ସେଇ ବାଟେ ବାଟେ ଯା ।
literal_meaning: Good of you to come, friend; there is nowhere to sit. Go back by the very way you came.
explanation: The opening sounds hospitable, but the ending cancels the welcome. The humour lies in that sudden reversal: someone offers warm words while making it plain that the visitor is unwanted. Used pointedly, it exposes courtesy that provides no actual welcome.
meaning_odia: ମୁହଁରେ ସ୍ୱାଗତ କରି କାମରେ ଅନାଦର କରିବା।
usage_example: A club warmly invites suggestions but immediately dismisses every visitor’s proposal; an observer recalls this saying. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The repeated address to a friend sharpens the irony. The example extends that verbal pattern to another setting; no historical hospitality custom is being asserted.
